text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Prime Minister Alfred Sant, speaking at a political meeting on Sunday, said the system of Value Added Tax had uncovered tax evasion but his government was still committed to removing it because it had led to economic slowdown.
- Sea Malta chairman Karmenu Farrugia has stepped down from the chairmanship, three months after being appointed. He gave no reason for leaving.
- Cabinet discussing social housing project involving upto 1,200 units to be built in partnership with the private sector.
- Nationalist Party to intensify fund-raising for new television station.
